verdicts.reason: At 44eca17, owner detail builds the selector solely from workspaceBootstrap.studies (research-intake-ui.js:122), while partnership SQL appends studies only inside a partner loop (20261018-research-partnerships.sql:248-263); an owner study created before any partnership is reachable through the ordinary bootstrap query (20261013-research-management.sql:132-139) but absent from this selector, though incidence in stored data was not measured.

At 44eca17, creating a draft appends created.study with revision 0 to the local list (research-intake-ui.js:126), approval reuses any integer cached revision without studyGet (line 129), and memberSet bumps the study revision (20261013-research-management.sql:289); approving a second application into that same draft on the still-open intake page therefore sends stale revision 0 and conflicts, with the reachable first-then-second approval path shown by these callers.

At 44eca17, createPublicClient awaits fetch without a signal or deadline (research-intake-ui.js:25), while the shared button helper disables its button until the async submit handler settles (research-client.js button); a fetch that never settles therefore leaves submission pending and blocks a same-page retry, and reloading loses the in-memory pending requestId, though network-stall incidence was not measured.

At 44eca17, focus or persisted pageshow calls load (research-intake-ui.js:2-3), which snapshots draft and acknowledgement before awaiting intakePublicInfo (lines 76-77) and then replaces the controls using that snapshot (lines 53-71); editing or unchecking during the pending request is a reachable ordering that loses the newer state, though incidence was not measured independently.

At 44eca17, the UI still offers 'save in review' when application.status is under_review (research-intake-ui.js:118-120), but intakeReview rejects any decision equal to the current status before writing the revision and review entry (20261020-partnership-intake.sql:122,135-136); a second note on an already-under-review application therefore always conflicts even with the current revision.

At 44eca17, detail waits for intakeGet before setting route and replacing root (research-intake-ui.js:111), whereas terms renders immediately once ownerInfo is loaded (line 99), and the shared epoch guard changes only on clear, not view navigation (lines 93-96); opening detail then terms before intakeGet resolves lets the late detail response overwrite the newer terms view, though incidence was not measured.

At 44eca17, the new intake route passes jobStore() to handleIntake (practice-server.mjs:200), jobStore constructs supabaseStore without timeoutMs (line 171), and supabaseStore only adds AbortSignal.timeout when that option is supplied (access.mjs:1766-1770); a stalled token-secret lookup on intakeSubmit (research-intake.mjs:35) can therefore hold the request indefinitely, though incidence was not measured.

At 44eca17, the diff adds public research-partnership.html, but screens-menu.js:20-24 omits it from the gateway inventory even though CLAUDE.md:443 explicitly requires adding each new screen there with matching audience; the precondition is simply viewing the owner's central menu after this page is introduced.
